summary.intent: Execute phase 22 (performance-baselines-completion) plans, after first correcting that the phase 22 planning commits had landed directly on main instead of a feature branch.
summary.outcome: Phase 22 planning commits were moved to feat/phase-22-performance-baselines-completion, main was reset to origin/main, and all 3 phase 22 plans (SDK perf instrumentation, E2E journey timing, load test thresholds) were dispatched as parallel subagents for execution.

repo: Phase 22 is named 'performance-baselines-completion' — slug derived from .planning/phases directory name
GSD branching strategy for this project uses 'phase' strategy, generating branch names like feat/phase-{N}-{slug}
All 3 phase 22 plans fall in a single wave (no inter-plan dependencies), enabling full parallel execution
workflow: GSD planning commits should go to feat/phase-{N}-{slug} branches, not directly to main
When phase commits land on main before push, the safe recovery is: create feature branch at current HEAD, then git reset --hard origin/main on main
GSD execute-phase init returns branch_name pre-computed; if a matching branch already exists from a prior step, skip the checkout -b and reuse it
The gsd-tools init execute-phase command provides executor_model, verifier_model, parallelization, plans, incomplete_plans, and branch metadata in one call

friction: Phase 22 planning commits were accidentally made directly to main instead of a feature branch, requiring manual branch surgery before execution could proceed
open_items: 3 executor subagents (22-01, 22-02, 22-03) were spawned but transcript ends before their completion — verification, regression gate, and roadmap update steps are not yet done
